summary.text: Jacob Luria is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is vice chair of the Libertarian Party of Colorado and ran for the Colorado House of Representatives in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Jacob Luria was born in Albany, New York.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he joined the Libertarian Party in 2018 after leaving the Republican Party and was then the campaigns director for the Libertarian Party of Colorado.
He said he moved to Colorado from New York and lived in Golden.

Luria was the Libertarian candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 27 in 2022, when incumbent Democrat Brianna Titone won the general election and Luria received 2.5 percent of the vote.
In his 2022 survey he listed educational freedom, energy independence (nuclear) and inflation and debt as his key messages.
